evidence: Modifies `BlockManager::WriteBlock` and `WriteBlockUndo` in `src/node/blockstorage.cpp` to handle write errors gracefully.
rationale: Ensures disk write failures during block and undo storage trigger clean node shutdown rather than an unhandled process termination. Disks running out of space during block writes previously triggered an unhandled exception in `BufferedWriter`'s destructor, aborting the process without clean error reporting.
